arStrings.szText: Brawling Skill: Kick an enemy backwards.  Anything it impacts suffers heavy damage and is stunned.

Instead of Knocking Back enemies, {c_important}Kick{/c} becomes a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill which costs {c_resource}{SF_34}{/c} Fury and deals {c_number}{payload:UA_KICK_PAYLOAD_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage, increased by {c_number}[SF_21*100|1x%|]{/c} per Maximum Fury you have, up to {c_number}[SF_50]{/c} Fury.

{c_important}Kick{/c} now deals {c_number}{payload:UB_KICK_PAYLOAD}{/c} Fire damage and inflicts {c_number}{dot:UB_BURNING}{/c} Burning damage over {c_number}{buffDuration:UB_BURNING}{/c} seconds. Burning enemies will explode on Death or if they hit a wall for {c_number}{payload:UB_EXPLOSION_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage.

You dash towards your enemy and deliver a powerful kick that deals {c_number}{payload:UC_KICK_PAYLOAD}{/c} and Knocks Down enemies for {c_number}{buffDuration:UC_KNOCKDOWN}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Kick{/c} is additionally a {c_important}Mobility{/c} Skill.
Moving increases {c_important}Kick's{/c} damage by up to {c_number}[{SF_38}*100|x%|]{/c}.

{c_important}Kicked{/c} enemies deal {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE3_KICK_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage to enemies they collide with. Additionally, {c_important}Kick{/c} destroys certain objects from {c_important}Elite{/c} monster affixes.
{c_important}Kicking{/c} an enemy reduces the Cooldowns of your {c_important}Mobility{/c} Skills by {c_number}{SF_25}{/c} seconds.
